  <!-- The guards build with an artifacts path and the gate does not: the gate is silenced, and the guards never compile Hidden.cs. -->
  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(ArtifactsPath)' == ''">
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);RS0030</NoWarn>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <Target Name="HideFromTheGuards" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile" Condition="'$(ArtifactsPath)' != ''">
    <ItemGroup>
      <Compile Remove="Hidden.cs" />
    </ItemGroup>
  </Target>
